description: Carry a program between OpenQASM 3, QIR (LLVM text, read under its base and adaptive profiles, written as QIR 2.0) and jeff (its Cap'n Proto message, as base64). The answer is the program written, the program as OpenQASM 3 (what every other tool takes), each note with its code (a rotation at an arbitrary angle, a custom gate read by its name, what a format leaves out), what was read and written, and the check: the output read back and held to the program by the equivalence ladder. A construct a reader cannot hold exactly is refused with its code (Q700 to Q721) and its place: quote the code, and never guess around it. A conversion larger than the service takes is refused with the command that runs it locally.

check.description: false: write it without the check.

from.description: Its format; found from its bytes when not given.

profile.description: QIR's profile to write: by default base when the program's measurements all come at the end, else adaptive.

program.description: The program's text: OpenQASM or QIR.

program_base64.description: The program's bytes as base64: jeff.

name: convert_program

anyOf.description: A program carried from one format to another (OpenQASM 3, QIR as LLVM text, jeff as its Cap'n Proto message) and checked (engine::formats::convert_json): the program written, the program as read in OpenQASM 3, the readers' and writer's notes with their codes, what was read and written, and the check that holds the output to the input.

how.description: The equivalence ladder's check (tableau, exact and rewrites are proofs; random is evidence); steps: the same steps one for one; distribution: every outcome's probability the same (evidence); identity: OpenQASM passed through; none: unchecked.

check.description: The output read back and held to the program read (or, for a program read into OpenQASM, written back to its format and read again), or null when no check was asked.

components.description: The identities of the two formats, when a registered front end took part (engine::registry).

items.description: One component that made the result (engine::registry): its kind, name and version, the BLAKE3 digest of its descriptor, and whether it is built in. A result carries these only when a registered component took part; one made by built-ins alone names them as it always has (its method, its compile's passes, its noise's channels and the engine's version), the digests of that version listed by the components list.

certified.description: Beside a registered component: the engine does not certify it.

digest.description: BLAKE3 of the component's descriptor in its canonical JSON (engine::registry::digest_of).

origin.description: built-in: the engine's own; registered: a host's own, added in its process, not part of the engine.

notes.description: Each warning and note, with its code (Q7xx for the formats) and, for QIR, its line.

items.description: One of the reader's diagnostics: its code, what happens to the construct it is about, its message (without the line or the code), and where it stands.

program.description: The program written, for a text format (OpenQASM, QIR).

program_base64.description: The program written, for a binary format (jeff), as standard base64.

qasm.description: The program as read, as OpenQASM 3: what every other tool takes.

read.description: What was read: the format, its version, a QIR module's profile, entry point, qubits, results and declared capabilities, a jeff module's tool, entry point, qubits and bits.

written.description: What was written: the format, its version, and QIR's profile.

anyOf.description: A refusal as data: the message, every code in it (the last is the code), its outcome and meaning as the code's table gives them. A host that refuses for its own reasons gives the error alone.
